resources.string: Your connections and data in one place.
No sleep or HRV data downloaded for today.
Plan your next fitness goal in the calendar.
Connect Garmin to download your training.
Copy report and open my project
Paste the text into your chosen conversation and send it.
One race, all distances. Choose your goal.
No races match. Change the date or filters.
Races, events and plans to move.
No events added for this day.
Connected with a personal API key
Your personal key is encrypted on this device and sent only to Garmin over HTTPS.
Data refreshes when the app opens and about every 4 hours with a network connection. Android may defer background work to save battery.
Create a ChatGPT project and copy its URL from your browser. bAIr copies your report and opens the project. Paste it into a new or existing conversation and send it.
No API key needed. From Home, prepare a report and share it using Android.
Review the full text before sharing. Replies stay in ChatGPT and do not return to bAIr automatically.
Import nutrition from a CSV file. A direct API connection is not available yet.
CSV files are processed on your device. No MyFitnessPal password is needed.
Light and dark colors follow your system settings.
Add upcoming events manually or from the catalogue. Garmin Personal API does not expose future calendar events.
Your calendar is stored locally. Events are not sent to Garmin.
Removes downloaded metrics and activities. Keeps calendar events and your Garmin connection.
Your Garmin key and local Garmin data will be deleted. Calendar and MyFitnessPal data will remain.
Downloaded Garmin and MyFitnessPal metrics, activities, sleep and HRV will be deleted. Your calendar and Garmin key will remain.
No activities downloaded for today. Sync after your next workout.
Connect Garmin to see your workouts here.
Prepare a report covering the last 30 days and open it in ChatGPT. No API key needed.
bAIr shows the full report first. Data leaves the app only when you choose to share it.
This is the exact text to be shared. Your Garmin key and access token are not included.
Report copied. Paste it into a conversation in your project.
Unable to copy the report or open the project. Retry or use a new chat.
Source: racecalendar.bg · Your events are in your personal calendar.
Metrics and race history from BTR and ITRA. Saved data is included in your ChatGPT report.
If ITRA blocks direct access, Jina Reader reads the public profile URL. No keys or private Garmin data are sent.
Public page and previously saved values
Profile refreshed. Missing fields retain their previous values.
No results available. Refresh your profile or add data using Edit.
No app available to open this URL.
Garmin connected and today\'s data synced.
Garmin key and synced Garmin data removed from device.
No Garmin activities available. Sync history and try again.
Events are private and stored on this device. Garmin Personal API does not expose future calendar events.
bAIr reads the public HTTPS page from your phone. Review the extracted data before saving.
Data filled in. Review before saving.
Found the name but not the date. Review and fill in the remaining fields.
Distance must be a number, e.g. 42.2.
Elevation gain must be a whole number in metres.
Downloaded %1$d Garmin activities and sleep/HRV summaries for %2$d days.
Automatic Garmin sync failed. Try again later.
Create and keep structured workouts offline. Garmin upload needs a separate secure integration.
Check required names, positive duration/reps, repeat counts (1–50), and a maximum of 24 hours.
Operation failed. Local data was not intentionally cleared.
Imported as a new local workout.
Invalid or unsupported workout JSON (maximum 500 KB).
The last attempt needs review before retrying.

Upload is not connected in this build. No secure backend or authenticated Garmin test account is available. Your existing Personal API reading connection is unchanged; workout creation through that API has not been verified.

The researched unofficial integration uses Garmin sign-in, sessions and MFA. These must stay on a trusted backend, not in Android or ChatGPT. No Garmin username/password form is included. See docs/workout-builder.md for deployment options and verification steps.
No exact verified Garmin identifier; these steps would use generic instructions without an exercise animation:
I explicitly allow these generic steps in the preview. This does not upload anything.
Payload conversion is tested with mocks. Acceptance by Garmin Connect and display on Enduro 3 are unverified. A Connect upload is not proof of delivery to the watch.
Connect to your own HTTPS server. Garmin sign-in and MFA happen only in its trusted console. Enter the backend pairing key here, never your Garmin password or Personal API key.
A pairing key is stored encrypted. Leave the field empty to reuse it only for the saved server address.
I trust this personal server to access my Garmin workouts.
Backend is reachable, but Garmin sign-in is needed in the server console.
Check the backend pairing key and complete Garmin sign-in/MFA in the server console.
Too many requests. Wait before retrying.
The workout or connection settings are not supported. Check the HTTPS origin, pairing key and workout steps.
This workout or pending request belongs to another backend/Garmin account. Do not update it from this connection.
The result is uncertain. Use Check result first and inspect Garmin Connect. Do not create a duplicate blindly.
Connection failed. Check your server and trusted HTTPS certificate. If an upload was started, use Check result before retrying.
Disconnect and delete server Garmin session
Deletes the encrypted Garmin session on this personal backend and forgets this phone pairing key. Workouts already in Garmin Connect are not deleted. This is not Garmin-side token revocation.
Server Garmin session deleted; phone pairing forgotten.
Forget access on this phone only
Phone access forgotten. The server session is unchanged; delete it from the server console if needed.
I explicitly allow these generic steps without exercise animations.
Send this structured workout through the saved personal backend? Garmin Connect acceptance does not mean it has reached the watch.
A previous attempt has an uncertain result. Check it instead of sending again.
Garmin Connect returned workout ID %1$s. Verify the workout in Connect, then send it to Enduro 3 with the normal Bluetooth synchronization.

Unofficial Garmin integration. Your own deployed backend and a valid session are required. Real Connect acceptance and Enduro 3 display need your verification; Bluetooth delivery is not confirmed by an upload response.
